headline: European Commission proposes a Cloud and AI Development Act with capacity and sovereignty measures
summary: On 3 June 2026, the European Commission proposed the Cloud and AI Development Act (CADA), combining measures to accelerate sustainable data-centre deployment with a common cloud and AI sovereignty framework and coordinated public-sector procurement. The proposal aims to at least triple EU data-centre capacity within five to seven years. Its impact assessment estimates that EU27 installed capacity would reach 12.4 GW in 2025 while supply fell almost 3 GW short of estimated demand; its market figures rely on an external study that excludes private enterprise sites, including many dedicated HPC facilities. As of the 2026-11-02 check, Parliament listed the proposal as awaiting committee decision. These remain proposal terms and Commission estimates, not enacted policy or verified market-wide outcomes.
